title: Pass owner (package.json team) in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching package.json team (hardcoded, as apps are bundled and don't read package.json). Single PR since libs/shared-contracts is inlined at build. Assumed packages/* are unrelated and don't call validateApp (grep confirmed).
